item.title: Deleting Various Socials
item.description: Since 2019, I’ve been on social media to keep myself informed of various hobbies and interests, and to keep my mind stimulated. Nonetheless, I’ve never been the kind of person to like communicating online publicly. Also, there are certain forms of social media that are complete overstimulation for me. With various laws being proposed in this nation, but more importantly, to make things simpler for me, I will be deleting social media accounts that I would prefer not to use. Due to positive lifestyle changes that I have made, I feel confident that I will not find myself rushing to create those accounts again.

item.title: Move to Anatole Theme
item.description:
With the uBlogger theme no longer maintained, I have moved this site to the Anatole Hugo theme, which can be found here: https://github.com/lxndrblz/anatole

Credit for this theme goes to all contributors behind its development.

item.title: EVC Project Photographs
item.description: I tried to make photographs of the Electric Vehicle Conversion project look snazzy in the uBlogger Hugo theme. I’m just going to direct you to an album in my PixelFed account instead: http://link.stevenkorvin.com/PG8kwp
